messages:
jordan: Alert from alertmanager: hosted-usw2 GPU pool 'pool-2' p95 queueing latency > 6s for 10m. Dashboard flagged sustained admission rejects. looks correlated with embeddings tenant spike. @oncall can we triage?
ops-bot: alert fired: GPU_POOL_QUEUE_P95 > 6s (hosted-usw2 pool-2) — runbook: /runbooks/gpu-queueing.
marta: looking... pulling p95 times now.
marta: PromQL used: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{pool="pool-2"}[5m])) by (le))` yields p95=6.8s over last 10m.
lee: any error spikes from proxy or egress? I'm seeing increased 503s on api-proxy-usw2: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{status="503"}[5m]))` up 3x.
samir: embeddings batch job flood from partner-X — they kicked off a large reindex this morning. Requests are large and bypassing KV cache.
jordan: can we temporarily lower admission for embeddings on hosted to protect latency for other customers? what knobs do we have?
marta: two quick levers: 1) spill a portion to eu1 fallback pool 2) tighten tenant rate limiter for embeddings model. 1) is lower customer-impact but increases cross-region egress/cost.
joy: cross-region routing cost estimate: rough ballpark $12k/day if spill is large and sustained. need to quantify.
carla: another fast option: enable more aggressive prefix KV caching + cap batch size for that tenant in runtime flags: `--kv-prefetch=true --max-batch=16`. Could reduce per-token work by ~20-30%.
lee: we can also apply an edge throttle via nginx: `limit_req zone=embeddings burst=50 nodelay;` quick to deploy and reduces admission load.
samir: pinged customer to ask for an immediate pause/backoff; they replied "working on it" ~1m ago.
marta: starting route spill: updating routing policy to route 30% of embeddings traffic from pool-2 to eu1-pool-5. Command: `rdctl route update --pool pool-2 --fallback eu1:pool-5 --spill 30%`
ops-bot: deploy job started: route-update v2 by marta — status: running.
marta: route update complete. monitoring... p95 dropped to 3.2s in the 5m window.
jordan: nice. samir keep pressing customer to reduce concurrency. joy can you calculate cost delta and tag incident?
joy: will run estimation and post in ~15m. initial quick calc lower bound ~$9k/day if sustained at 30% spill.
carla: filing follow-up: add autoscale/spill rule: trigger when pool p95 >5s OR queued_requests >200 for 5m. will open PR for dashboard + alert config.
lee: I'll add nginx limiter template to ops-snippets repo for quick edge throttles.
samir: customer updated: will drop concurrency by 70% for 2 hours. should help smoothing.
jordan: closing for now but keep 15m watch. please add postmortem/notes in /incidents if anything reoccurs. :thumbsup:
